notes:
Tests whether sonde troubleshooting survives a switch to stormwater interpretation, a refusal to invent a metals measurement, and indirect returns to the repair sequence.
Claims: mp-t6-scrambled-03, mp-dry-ports-08, mp-solvent-do-warning-09, mp-warning-message-07, mp-t6-clean-replace-07, mp-t6-display-off-02, v2x-predawn-battery-check, v2x-battery-brownout, v2x-marine-stormwater-discriminator, v2x-stormwater-contamination, v2x-turbidity-loading-proxy, v2x-maintenance-step, mp-cal-records-01, mp-inspect-cables-11, mp-cable-coil-07.
Turn roles: 1=early; 2=early; 3=early; 4=on-topic+cross-document; 5=switch; 6=on-topic+refusal; 7=return; 8=back-reference(2); 9=back-reference(3); 10=cross-document; 11=on-topic; 12=capped-back-reference(1).

turns.content: After a wet trip, our handheld sonde display is showing numbers that look scrambled or in the wrong scale. What should I check before deciding the sensors are bad?

must_contain: Checks that the correct measurement units are selected.
Inspects connectors for moisture.
Inspects connectors for dirt or damage.
Checks for loose connections.
must_not: Diagnoses a real change in water quality from the scrambled display alone.

turns.content: One sensor port is damp and we may need to fit a spare sensor. Can I dry the whole head with alcohol, including the optical oxygen face?

must_contain: Dries the sensor port before installing the replacement sensor.
Identifies compressed air as a port-drying option.
Warns that alcohol or other solvents can destroy the optical DO sensing surface.
Warns that alcohol or other solvents can damage some plastics and o-rings.
must_not: Recommends wiping the optical DO sensing surface with alcohol.

turns.content: There's also a warning on the display and one sensor looks physically damaged. Can the crew carry on after wiping it, or what has to happen?

must_contain: Does not use the instrument until the warning's underlying error is identified, understood, and corrected.
Replaces damaged sensors.
Recalibrates after replacing a damaged sensor.
must_not: Treats clearing the warning from the display as sufficient without correcting its cause.

turns.content: Tomorrow's start will be cold, and last week several channels dropped out together before dawn. What power-related checks should go on the list?

must_contain: Notes that battery performance decreases as temperature decreases.
Carries spare batteries.
Checks battery voltage for a pre-dawn anomaly.
Identifies simultaneous steps, noise, or dropouts across channels with falling battery voltage as a possible power brownout.
must_not: Declares a pre-dawn dropout to be a pollution event without checking power.

turns.content: Different site now: after rain at our marine outfall, the turbidity jumped while salinity and pH fell. What stormwater pattern does that fit, and what can be riding in with it?

must_contain: Recognizes a salinity or specific-conductance decrease near an outfall as part of the marine stormwater pattern.
Recognizes the turbidity spike coinciding with rain as a stormwater discriminator.
Identifies lower pH as part of the marine stormwater pattern.
Notes that stormwater can carry bacteria, metals, and hydrocarbons.
must_not: Treats the pattern as a direct measurement of a particular contaminant.

turns.content: So how many milligrams per litre of metals are in that water? We've only got the pod readings; can you work out the concentration from that spike?

must_contain: States that DataPods cannot measure the metals in stormwater.
Declines to supply a metals concentration from those pod measurements.
Describes a turbidity spike as a loading proxy rather than a measured metals concentration.
must_not: Invents a metals concentration or converts turbidity into milligrams per litre of metals.
Offers a typical numeric metals concentration as a substitute for the unavailable measurement.

turns.content: OK, back to the sonde we were repairing. We still see the warning after cleaning; should we put it back to work, and what about the damaged sensor?

must_contain: Keeps the instrument out of use until the error is identified, understood, and corrected.
Replaces the damaged sensor.
Recalibrates after replacement.
must_not: Continues interpreting the stormwater event instead of addressing the instrument warning.

turns.content: That damp socket and the face beside it from earlier - which part needs drying before the swap, and what should I keep the solvent off?

must_contain: Dries the sensor port before replacing the sensor.
Offers compressed air for drying the port.
Keeps alcohol and other solvents away from the optical DO sensing surface because they can destroy it.
Warns that solvents can also damage some plastics and o-rings.
must_not: Answers about contaminants in the stormwater sample instead of the damp sensor port.

turns.content: The warning and damaged part I mentioned near the start - is wiping the part and acknowledging the message enough to release the kit?

must_contain: Requires the underlying error to be identified, understood, and corrected before use.
Requires replacement of a damaged sensor.
Requires recalibration after sensor replacement.
must_not: Substitutes stormwater risk interpretation for the repair release requirements.
Treats acknowledging a warning as equivalent to correcting its cause.

turns.content: Once it's fixed, a serviced channel shows a sudden offset right when we worked on it. What record should I compare that with, and what checks need recording after replacement?

must_contain: Compares an abrupt offset in a serviced channel with the maintenance timestamp and log.
Recalibrates after replacing the damaged sensor.
Maintains calibration records in the appropriate instrument or sensor logbook.
must_not: Attributes an offset at the maintenance timestamp to a discharge without checking the maintenance log.

turns.content: We're ready to carry it back out. What should I inspect on the leads, and how tightly can I coil them in the case?

must_contain: Inspects cables for damage.
Inspects connectors and sensor ports for corrosion.
Uses cable coils no tighter than 6 inches in diameter.
Stores cables clean and dry.
must_not: Recommends tightly winding the cables into coils smaller than 6 inches in diameter.

turns.content: The strange display I opened with - remind me what to check in the settings and at the connections before blaming the water.

must_contain: Checks that the correct measurement units are selected.
Inspects connectors for moisture, dirt, or damage.
Checks for loose connections.
must_not: Answers about stormwater metals instead of troubleshooting the sonde display.
presents a guess about which earlier instrument or procedure is meant as though it were certain
